config.future_values: seven normalized state values on calendar days d+2 through d+8; internal missing observations masked
future_moments: signed finite mean of normalized z
log1p population variance of normalized z
fraction of finite future days with abs(z)>max(reference abs(z)90th percentile,0.1)
config.eligibility: identical node mask for both conditions; at least28 reference and5 future finite normalized observations; retain every original event origin
config.target_scaling: training-only equal-person base weights; each supported origin normalized by its valid coordinates; one shared scalar for values,one scalar per moment statistic; standard deviation fallback1 for constant targets
config.auxiliary_loss: Huber delta1 on standardized targets; mean over each origin's valid node/coordinate entries; zero for unsupported origins; average using equal-person base weights without class balancing
config.event_loss: unchanged person/class-balanced BCE and prediction prior-logit correction
config.decoder: shared WIDTH32->WIDTH32 GELU->7 or3 linear node decoder on graph_norm output; decoder outputs never enter the original risk head
config.selection: first seed selects lambda by validation AUROC,negative logloss for single class; exact ties retain0.1; selected lambda repeated for the other2 fixed seeds
config.ensemble: equal arithmetic mean of all3 fixed seed risk probabilities
config.test_policy: test remains unopened until all study methods are frozen; prediction does not construct auxiliary targets
config.interpretation: tests auxiliary target alignment; Huber/log-variance head is not an estimator of original-scale expected variance and no multitask novelty claim is made
